purpose: Teach: 潜ん/見送っ/史観/極秘/潜入/バイアス/毒性/頻発

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、戦時、本気で、絶対、地下に、絶対、潜んでいた知識人、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、立派、絶対、本気、絶対、感心、絶対。
lines.en: Ren, your paper on wartime intellectuals in hiding — that was genuinely impressive scholarship.
lines.style: Warm, measured opening. Recognition in the voice without performance. Steady pace, genuine interest. A teacher confirming what she already knows.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。戦時、本気で、絶対、見送った、絶対、若者の歴史、論文で、扱いました、本気で、深い、研究、絶対、本気、本気で、感謝、本当に、絶対。
lines.en: Thank you. I wanted to really understand the young people who witnessed those years — it felt important to get the depth right.
lines.style: Quiet sincerity. A slight lift of relief at being understood. Careful, thoughtful pacing. Respect for the subject matter threading through every word.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦後の史観、本気で、絶対、論文で、絶対、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、視野、広い、絶対、立派、絶対、感心、絶対、本気、絶対、本気で。
lines.en: And you brought so much perspective to the postwar historiography. Your analysis was really sophisticated.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slower pace. Picking words with care. Genuine appreciation, the kind that comes from actually reading the work. No rush.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。戦時、本気で、絶対、極秘の作戦、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、深い、研究、絶対、本気、本気で、感謝、本当に、絶対、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: Yes, I spent a lot of time with the classified operations archives. I wanted to show how much was hidden, and why that mattered to the historical record.
lines.style: Earnest, almost vulnerable. A slight tremor of intensity when discussing the research. Careful articulation — he's explaining something he cares about deeply.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦時、本気で、絶対、潜入記者、論文で、絶対、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、視野、広い、絶対、立派、絶対、本気で、感心、絶対、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: The way you handled the underground press — the journalists risking everything — that showed real maturity in your thinking.
lines.style: Genuine warmth. Leaning slightly forward in attention. Slower, deliberate delivery. The voice of someone confirming a student's potential.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。当時の報道、本気で、絶対、バイアス、絶対、強かった歴史、論文で、扱いました、本気で、深い、研究、絶対、本気、本気で、感謝、絶対、本気で。
lines.en: Thank you. I tried to show how biased the wartime reporting was, and how that shaped what people could know. That seemed like the whole point.
lines.style: Quieter here, more vulnerable. A small pause before answering, like he's checking that his understanding was right. Thoughtful, not defensive.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦時、本気で、絶対、毒性ガス、絶対、被害、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、辛い歴史、絶対、立派、絶対、本気で、感心、絶対、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: Your section on chemical weapons and civilian casualties — that couldn't have been easy to research, but you handled it with real dignity.
lines.style: Softer tone. Respect layered underneath. A slight slowness, like she's acknowledging the weight of what he chose to write about. Sincerity, not sympathy.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。戦時、本気で、絶対、空襲、絶対、頻発した時代、論文で、扱いました、本気で、深い、研究、絶対、本気、本気で、感謝、本当に、絶対、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: I wanted to honor those people — the ones who lived through the bombing campaigns. That history deserves to be told carefully.
lines.style: Quietest yet. Almost reflective. A pause before speaking, like he's back in the research. Steady, reverent pace. The voice of someone who carries what he's learned.
